reused.name: 3GPP-MS-TimeZone
reused.usage: Indicates the offset between universal time and local time in steps of 15 minutes of where the MS currently resides.This AVP shall have the 'M' bit cleared.

reused.name: 3GPP-SGSN-MCC-MNC
reused.usage: Indicates the serving core network operator ID. For GPRS accesses the MCC and the MNC of the SGSN.For EPS 3GPP/non-3GPP accesses, the MCC and the MNC provided by the SGW, ePDG or TWAG.This AVP shall have the 'M' bit cleared.

reused.name: 3GPP-User-Location-Info
reused.usage: Indicates details of where the UE is currently located (e.g. SAI or CGI), Coding for type values between 0 and 134 shall be done as defined in 3GPP TS 29.274 [33]. The values 135 and 137 corresponding to "NCGI" and "5GS TAI and NCGI" (which are not applicable in some specification using this AVP) shall be applicable. Coding for these type values shall be done as defined in 3GPP TS 29.061 [34]This AVP shall have the 'M' bit cleared.

reused.name: AN-GW-Address
reused.usage: Carries the IP address of the ePDG used as IPSec tunnel endpoint with the UE.This AVP shall have the ‘M’ bit cleared.

reused.name: AN-Trusted
reused.usage: Indicates whether the access network is trusted or untrusted for the Non-3GPP access network. This AVP shall have the 'M' bit cleared.

reused.name: Called-Asserted-Identity
reused.usage: The address (Public User ID: SIP URI, E.164, etc.) of the finally asserted called party.

reused.name: Called-Party-Address
reused.usage: The address (SIP URI, Tel URI or URN) of the party to whom the call is addressed.

reused.name: Called-Station-Id
reused.usage: The PDN the user is connected to. For GPRS and EPS the APN. When used to contain the APN, the APN is composed of the APN Network Identifier only, or the APN Network Identifier and the APN Operator Identifier as specified in TS 23.003 [38], clause 9.1. The inclusion of the APN Operator Identifier can be configurable.

reused.name: Calling-Party-Address
reused.usage: The address (SIP URI or Tel URI) which identifies the party (Public User Identity or Public Service Identity) initiating a SIP transaction.This information may be used by the PCRF, for example, to provide the caller information in the PCC rule decision for further volume based charging.

reused.name: DRMP
reused.usage: Allows Diameter endpoints to indicate the relative priority of Diameter transactions.

reused.name: Final-Unit-Action
reused.usage: The action applied by the PCEF when the user’s account cannot cover the service cost.

reused.name: Framed-IP-Address
reused.usage: The valid routable Ipv4 address that is applicable for the IP Flows towards the UE at the PCEF. The PCRF shall use this address to identify the correct IPCAN session (session binding). For example, the IP address may actually be that of the network interface of a NAT device between the UE and the GW. The values0xFFFFFFFF and 0xFFFFFFFE are not applicable as described in RFC 4005 [12].

reused.name: Framed-Ipv6-Prefix
reused.usage: A valid full Ipv6 address that is applicable to an IP flow or IP flows towards the UE at the PCEF. The PCRF shall use this address to identify the correct IP-CAN session (session binding, refer to TS 29.213 [9]). For example, the IP address may actually be that of the network interface of a NAT device between the UE and the GW.The encoding of the value within this Octet String type AVP shall be as defined in RFC 3162 [20], clause 2.3. The "Reserved", "Prefix-Length" and "Prefix" fields shall be included in this order. The AF shall set the "Prefix Length" to 128 and encode the Ipv6 address of the UE within the "Prefix" field.

reused.name: Granted-Service-Unit
reused.usage: The volume and/or time thresholds for sponsored data connectivity. Only CC-Total-Octets, one of the CC-Input-Octets and CC-Output-Octets, or CC-Time AVPs are reused.This AVP shall have the ‘M’ bit cleared.

metadata.name: Granted-Service-Unit
metadata.grammar_source: RFC 8506 §§8.17/8.19; TS 29.214 V20.0.0 Table 5.4.0.1 and §5.4.1 (defined members restricted; extension point retained)

reused.name: IP-CAN-Type
reused.usage: IP-CAN type of the user.

reused.name: Load
reused.usage: The AVP used to convey load information between Diameter nodes.This AVP and all AVPs within this grouped AVP shall have the 'M' bit cleared.

reused.name: Max-PLR-DL
reused.usage: indicates ratio of lost packets per number of packets sent in unit of tenth of percent for a downlink voice service data flow.

reused.name: Max-PLR-UL
reused.usage: indicates ratio of lost packets per number of packets sent in unit of tenth of percent for an uplink voice service data flow.

reused.name: NetLoc-Access-Support
reused.usage: Indicates the level of support for NetLoc procedures provided by the current access network.

reused.name: OC-OLR
reused.usage: Contains the necessary information to convey an overload report.

reused.name: OC-Supported-Features
reused.usage: Defines the support for the Diameter overload indication conveyence by the sending node.

reused.name: Pre-emption-Capability
reused.usage: Indicates whether a service data flow can get resources that were already assigned to another service data flow with a lower priority level.

reused.name: Pre-emption-Vulnerability
reused.usage: Indicates whether a service data flow can lose the resources assigned to it in order to admit a service data flow with higher priority level.

reused.name: RAN-NAS-Release-Cause
reused.usage: Indicates RAN and/or NAS release cause code information. TWAN release cause code information or untrusted WLAN release cause code information.

reused.name: RAT-Type
reused.usage: Indicate which Radio Access Technology is currently serving the UE.

reused.name: Requested-Party-Address
reused.usage: The address (SIP URI, Tel URI or URN) of the party to whom the call was originaly addressed.

reused.name: Reference-Id
reused.usage: Indicates the transfer policy stored in the SPR.

reused.name: Reservation-Priority
reused.usage: The vendor-id shall be set to ETSI (13019) [15].The support of this AVP shall be advertised in the capabilities exchange mechanisms (CER/CEA) by including the ETSI parameter in the Supported-Vendor-Id AVP.

reused.name: Subscription-Id
reused.usage: The identification of the subscription (IMSI, MSISDN, etc.).

reused.name: Supported-Features
reused.usage: If present, this AVP informs the destination host about the features that the origin host requires to successfully complete this command exchange.

reused.name: TCP-Source-Port
reused.usage: Contains the TCP source port number in the case that a NAT and firewall are detected and the IKEv2 messages exchanged between the UE and the ePDG are transported using the firewall traversal tunnel as described in 3GPP TS 24.302 [50].This AVP shall have the ‘M’ bit cleared.

reused.name: TWAN-Identifier
reused.usage: Indicates the UE location in a Trusted WLAN or Untrusted WLAN Access Network.This AVP shall have the ‘M’ bit cleared.

reused.name: ToSTrafficClass
reused.usage: Indicates the DSCP code to be used for packet filter. The first octet contains the DSCP code and the second octet contains the mask field set to 11111100.

reused.name: UDP-Source-Port
reused.usage: Contains the UDP source port number in the case that NAT is detected and the IKEv2 messages exchanged between the UE and the ePDG are encapsulated in the UDP messages according to IETF RFC 3948 [49].This AVP shall have the ‘M’ bit cleared.

reused.name: UE-Local-IP-Address
reused.usage: Indicates the local IP address of the UE.This AVP shall have the ‘M’ bit cleared.

reused.name: Used-Service-Unit
reused.usage: The measured volume and/or time for sponsored data connectivity. Only CC-Total-Octets, one of the CC-Input-Octets and CC-Output-Octets, or CC-Time AVPs are reused.This AVP shall have the ‘M’ bit cleared.

metadata.name: Used-Service-Unit
metadata.grammar_source: RFC 8506 §§8.17/8.19; TS 29.214 V20.0.0 Table 5.4.0.1 and §5.4.1 (defined members restricted; extension point retained)

reused.name: User-Equipment-Info
reused.usage: The identification and capabilities of the terminal (IMEISV, etc.)When the User-Equipment-Info-Type is set to IMEISV(0), the value within the User-Equipment-Info-Value shall be a UTF-8 encoded decimal.

reused.name: User-Equipment-Info-Extension
reused.usage: The identification and capabilities of the terminal (IMEISV, IMEI, etc.)When the User-Equipment-Info-IMEISV or the User-Equipment-Info-IMEI is used, it shall be a UTF-8 encoded decimal.

reused.name: User-Location-Info-Time
reused.usage: Indicates the time the UE was last known to be in the location.
